clue.text: Pictures of a mince pie

indicators.note: printer's pie is a jumble of spilled type, so the letters of a mince are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A request to see snapshots of a mince pie, perhaps at Christmas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pie' looks like part of the food, but printer's pie is jumbled type, so it signals the anagram of A MINCE.
explanation.definitionFit: Going to the pictures is an older British idiom for going to the cinema, the place films are shown.

clue.text: Policeman's new crisp 12

definitions.note: the 's stands for 'is', so the definition is the policeman himself

indicators.note: something new is made over, so these letters are put into a fresh order

parts.note: the solution to 12 across, a bit of music

explanation.surface: A police officer's banknote, as fresh and crisp as they come.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new crisp 12' reads as a fresh banknote, but 'new' rearranges CRISP plus NOTE, the answer to 12 across.
explanation.definitionFit: An inspector is a rank of police officer, above sergeant in British forces.

clue.text: Plate attaining celebrity among the Spanish

indicators.note: one piece placed among the letters of another, so it goes inside

parts.note: el is the Spanish word for the
a name is a famous person, as in 'a big name'

explanation.surface: A dish gains fame in Spain.
explanation.definitionFit: To plate a metal is to coat it, and enamel is likewise applied as a coating, a verb sense.

clue.text: One in waiting for worker supporting a dry purpose

indicators.note: in a down clue a supporting piece sits beneath the others, so it comes last

parts.note: TT is teetotal, abstaining from alcohol
an end is an aim or goal
the worker ant is the classic crossword worker

explanation.surface: Someone waiting on a labourer who backs a teetotal cause.
explanation.definitionFit: An attendant waits upon someone, like a lady-in-waiting.

clue.text: Self-confident and convinced about City

indicators.note: the outer word goes round the other, as 'about' means surrounding

parts.note: being sure means being convinced
EC is the postcode area of the City of London, the financial district

explanation.surface: A confident person certain about the financial district.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone secure is free of anxiety, assured in themselves.

clue.text: Walk jauntily, given support

definitions.meaning: a brace or bar holding up a structure

explanation.definitionFit: The verb is a swaggering walk; the noun is a structural brace.

clue.text: Fall on jazz fan taking a right turn

parts.note: cat is jazz slang for a fan or musician
a turn is a stage act, as in a music-hall turn

explanation.surface: A jazz fan tumbles after turning right.
explanation.definitionFit: A cataract is a large waterfall, a steep fall of water.

clue.text: Country sportsmen backing God

parts.note: RU is Rugby Union, a team sport

indicators.note: going backwards, so the word for the god is read in reverse

parts.note: a Lar is a Roman household god

explanation.surface: Rural sportsmen supporting their deity.
explanation.definitionFit: Country as an adjective, as in country life, means relating to the countryside.

clue.text: Laurel tree originally following in second

indicators.note: these pieces follow the first piece, so they come after it

parts.note: Stan Laurel of the comedy duo Laurel and Hardy

indicators.note: the original letter of a word is its first

explanation.surface: A tree of the laurel family appearing in a moment.
explanation.definitionFit: A second and an instant are both very brief moments of time.

clue.text: No apologies for compiler's change involving 1 and 10

parts.note: the compiler is the setter, who says 'I'm' for 'compiler is'

indicators.note: one thing involving another wraps around it

parts.note: pence are small coins, loose change
I is the Roman numeral one
ten written out as a word

explanation.surface: A setter refuses to apologise for altering clues 1 and 10.
explanation.walkthrough: '1 and 10' look like cross-references to other answers, but here they are simply the numbers one and ten; 'involving' puts them inside the change.
explanation.definitionFit: Impenitence is a lack of remorse, so making no apologies.

clue.text: Reverse role — sailor as pest eliminator?

indicators.note: reverse tells us to read both words backwards

parts.note: a part is an actor's role
a tar is a sailor

explanation.surface: Swapping roles as a sailor becomes a rodent exterminator.
explanation.definitionFit: A device for catching vermin is a way of getting rid of rodents; the question mark marks the playful description.

clue.text: Chirpy cat is mad about mental health

indicators.note: mad, out of order, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A cheerful cat is crazy about mental wellbeing.
explanation.definitionFit: Psychiatric means relating to mental illness and its treatment.

clue.text: Mysteriously retreat, run away in friendly surrounds

indicators.note: the friendly word surrounds the other, holding it inside

parts.note: pally means friendly

indicators.note: letters sent away from their order are scrambled

explanation.surface: A strange retreat as someone flees from friendly surroundings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mysteriously' looks like an adverb modifying the retreat, but it is the definition; 'away' scrambles the two words before 'surrounds' wraps them.
explanation.definitionFit: Preternaturally means beyond the natural, in a supernatural or mysterious way.

clue.text: A bit of music when school's over

indicators.note: turned over, so the school's name is read backwards

parts.note: Eton is the famous English public school; the 's is just 'is'

explanation.surface: A tune heard once the school day ends.
explanation.definitionFit: A note is a single musical sound, a small bit of music.

clue.text: It protects the furniture of clergy on board

indicators.note: in an across clue one piece on another follows it

parts.note: a board is a table, as in board and lodging
the cloth means the clergy collectively

explanation.surface: Something guarding furnishings belonging to clergy on a committee.
explanation.definitionFit: A tablecloth covers and protects the table surface beneath it.

clue.text: Cavalryman protecting a virtuous soul from bomber

indicators.note: the cavalryman protects by holding the others inside

parts.note: a lancer is a mounted soldier with a lance
ST is short for saint, a holy person

explanation.surface: A horseman shielding a good person from aerial attack.
explanation.definitionFit: The Avro Lancaster was a famous British bomber of the Second World War.

clue.text: Ale vendor finding it too much to bear?

definitions.text: Ale vendor finding it too much to bear?

indicators.text: finding it too much to bear
indicators.note: letters overburdened collapse into disorder, so the seller's letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A beer seller struggling under their load.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both the wordplay and the definition: an ale vendor loaded with too many barrels.
explanation.definitionFit: Overladen means carrying too heavy a load, unable to bear it.

clue.text: Degree given to canto of sorts in European city

indicators.note: a piece given to another is added on, here after it

parts.note: bel canto is a style of singing, so bel names a sort of canto
a grade is a level or degree

explanation.surface: A degree awarded for some poem section in a continental capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'canto of sorts' clues BEL through bel canto, an Italian operatic singing style.
explanation.definitionFit: Belgrade is the capital city of Serbia.

clue.text: Highwayman carrying eastern books to the East gets thinner

indicators.note: the highwayman carries the others inside himself

parts.note: Dick Turpin was a famous English highwayman
NT is the New Testament, a set of books
E abbreviates East

explanation.surface: A robber with eastern scriptures heads East and loses weight.
explanation.definitionFit: Turpentine is a solvent used as a paint thinner.

clue.text: The woman's a goddess

parts.note: her is the possessive meaning the woman's

explanation.surface: A woman's divinity.
explanation.definitionFit: Hera is the Greek queen of the gods, wife of Zeus.

clue.text: Leave off, taking second to interrupt believer

indicators.note: to interrupt is to break into, so the piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a deist believes in God but not revelation

explanation.surface: Stop, letting a moment break into a believer's faith.
explanation.definitionFit: To desist is to stop doing something, to leave off.

clue.text: Net pay received by one tangling with latter-day Gypsy

indicators.note: pay is received by the net, so it goes inside

parts.note: a wage is pay
a raveller is one who ravels or tangles

explanation.surface: Take-home pay given to someone involved with a modern traveller.
explanation.definitionFit: New age travellers are modern itinerants, a latter-day equivalent of travelling folk.

clue.text: Shakespeare's beloved seizes 9 part 1 in fury

indicators.note: taking hold and enclosing, so one piece goes inside

parts.note: Mr W.H. is the dedicatee of Shakespeare's sonnets
the first part of the answer to 9 across

explanation.surface: Shakespeare's lover grabs part of something and flies into a rage.
explanation.definitionFit: Wrath is intense anger, a synonym for fury.

clue.text: Fashion in which Tyrannosaurus Rex heads for extinction

indicators.note: the heads of words are their first letters

parts.note: an end is a termination, as extinction is

explanation.surface: Dinosaurs are trendy, heading for extinction.
explanation.definitionFit: A trend is a fashion or current style.

clue.text: Proceed from sea cow, back to front

indicators.note: the back letter moves to the front

parts.note: the manatee is called a sea cow

explanation.surface: Moving from a manatee, rear to the fore.
explanation.definitionFit: To emanate is to issue or proceed from a source.

clue.text: Threefold Arab city in spasm

indicators.note: one piece placed in the other

parts.note: a tic is a muscular spasm
Riad is a variant spelling of Riyadh, capital of Saudi Arabia

explanation.surface: A city in Arabia tripled in convulsion.
explanation.definitionFit: Triadic means relating to a triad, a group of three.

clue.text: Guideline for most of the study

indicators.note: most of a word is all but its last letter

parts.note: to read a subject is to study it

explanation.surface: A guideline for the main part of research.
explanation.definitionFit: A thread is a guiding line, as in the thread of an argument.

clue.text: Model in check on a piece of viewing apparatus

indicators.note: the model is placed in the check

parts.note: to rein is to check or restrain
the Model T Ford gives T

explanation.surface: A fashion model in checks on part of a camera.
explanation.definitionFit: The retina is the light-sensitive part of the eye, our viewing apparatus.
